summary: Round 7 end-to-end testing of the public AAWTA CEC Events Calendar + registration and the dashboard Events|Calendar management. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_round7_events.py — 12/13 passed, 1 real bug found (un-check-in clobbers 'waitlist' status). Covered: GET /api/public/events (only Approved/Scheduled + published + !archived, no _id, registered_count), q/category/format/state filters, GET /api/public/events/{id} + 404 for unpublished/unknown, /api/public/home events gate, POST /api/public/events/{id}/register (registered -> waitlist on capacity, registration_status=waitlist -> waitlist, closed -> 400, duplicate email (case-insensitive) -> 400, honeypot -> 400, bad email -> 422, unknown event -> 404), publish lifecycle (ambassador submit = Submitted/unpublished and hidden; member publish -> 403; staff publish -> visible + status Approved + portal notification delivered to submitting ambassador; unpublish/archive hide it while it stays in the dashboard list), registrations list/search with total+checked_in counts, check-in/undo, walk-in create (status walkin, checked_in true, no _id), 403 for non-owner member on registrations/walk-in, member cannot see another user's private pending event, 401 for anonymous /api/events. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): homepage home-calendar-section renders live event card + exact intro copy, no old 'CEC Ambassador Orientation / Date TBA' placeholder, view-full-calendar-btn -> /events; /events month/year selects, prev/next, Calendar/List toggle, events-search (live filtering incl. 'No events found'), 3 filters, 10-item colour legend, day chip click -> detail, Upcoming Events preview; detail page shows name/date/start time/city+state/category/Free-or-price and correct action label; register modal created a registration and showed 'You're on the waitlist!' (capacity full) and blocked the duplicate with an error toast; unknown id shows 'Event not available'. Dashboard (cookie tokA): nav label 'Events | Calendar', all 6 subtabs filter correctly, Publish/Unpublish toggles and reflect immediately on the public calendar, Registrations dialog (3 tabs) with attendee search, Check-In (check in/undo + walk-in add, counts update live), Badge Center (Print All + per-attendee badge button opened a print window containing the attendee/AAWTA markup), Add Event dialog has name/date/start time/category/format/city/state/capacity/paid+price/ticket URL/registration URL/image upload. Staff-created paid event (price $25 + ticket_url) went unpublished -> invisible publicly -> published -> visible with 'Purchase' / 'Purchase Tickets' external ticket link. Member (ambassador) role: sees 'Events | Calendar', Submit Event works (status Submitted), only Calendar/My Events/Published/Archived subtabs, zero publish/manage/approve controls.

minor.issue: Un-check-in hard-codes status='registered', so a waitlisted attendee that was checked in and then un-checked is silently promoted from 'waitlist' to 'registered'. This also inflates registered_count (capacity gate uses registered/checked_in/walkin) and can let a full event over-fill. Store/restore the prior status (or a separate checked_in flag only). Reproduced by test_uncheckin_does_not_clobber_waitlist_status.

No date filtering: past events are returned and rendered on the homepage calendar section and in the /events list view (seeded 'Career Fair' 2026-07-10 still shows while 'today' is 2026-09-01). Only the 'Upcoming Events' preview filters by date. Consider hiding/segregating past events publicly.
No validation on date/start_time/capacity/price formats (start_time is a free-text string, capacity accepts any int incl. 0/negative). Low risk but allows inconsistent public display.

ui_bugs.issue: Dates are parsed with new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') which is UTC midnight; for users in negative-UTC timezones (e.g., US Eastern) the card, detail page and calendar cell will show the previous day. Parse as local (new Date(y, m-1, d)) or append T00:00.
'Paid event' checkbox and the 'Archive' button have no data-testid (all other controls do), which blocks automated coverage of the paid toggle / archive path.
events-search fires an API request on every keystroke (no debounce) — noticeable request storm while typing.

issues: Date uses the browser-native <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy picker) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere in the design system
Start time is a free-text input with no format hint/mask (accepted '6:00 PM'); a time input or select would prevent inconsistent public display
Hero heading block only occupies the left half; the right half is empty dark space at 1920px
Events without image_file_id show a large empty light-grey image block with a small calendar glyph — could be reduced or replaced with a branded gradient

action_items: Fix PUT /api/registrations/{id}/checkin so un-check-in restores the previous status instead of forcing 'registered' (waitlist attendees get silently promoted and capacity gate is bypassed).
Decide/implement past-event handling for /api/public/events and /api/public/home (past events currently render on the homepage calendar section and list view).
Fix UTC date parsing in EventCard/PublicEventDetail/portal Events (off-by-one day for negative-UTC users).
Add data-testid to the 'Paid event' checkbox and the 'Archive' button in portal/Events.jsx; debounce events-search.
critical_code_review_comments: checkin_registration overwrites the registration status; persist the pre-check-in status (e.g. prev_status) or keep status independent of checked_in.
server.py is 1636 lines — events/registrations block is a clean candidate for extraction into its own router module.
_public_evq is used consistently for all public event reads (good); public register also re-checks it, so the publish gate cannot be bypassed.

Email integration returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for @example.com test addresses (verified via /app/backend/tests/probe_email.py) — expected sandbox behaviour, handled non-fatally by send_safe; not a defect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows rendered and integrated correctly (issues found are date-TZ/design/testability, not broken flows)

rca_of_the_issue: checkin_registration() in server.py sets {'status': 'checked_in' if ci else 'registered'} unconditionally. For an attendee whose original status was 'waitlist', toggling check-in on and then off rewrites the status to 'registered'; because the capacity/registered_count queries count status in [registered, checked_in, walkin], the event's public registered_count grows and a full event can be over-filled. Fix: store the original status (e.g. base_status) at registration time and restore it when checked_in is set to false.
